cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis with Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 as the defining ether/sulfonate-type anionic, prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5 and Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @7, and no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signals toward strong: the olefin sulfonate is the only early surfactant (alkanolamide and glycerin sit between it and the buffers), the buffers are mid-list, no conditioning lipid, plus late salicylic/glycolic acid and citrus oil; also identity confidence moderate with a tier-4 source. These lower confidence but do not move the C1 value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led architecture with no silicone and no payload lipid; the only cationic polymers (Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @16, Polyquaternium-7 @20) sit after the fragrance, salt and preservative, so C2 is not met (no early silicone or prominent payload lipid). Counter-signal: two late cationic polymers plus Glycerin @4 and Glycol Distearate @6 could together read as several light routes (moderate).

excluded: Salicylic Acid @19, Glycolic Acid @35, Citric Acid @31 (acids)

weightPotential.wLineRecord: wLine PARFUM / FRAGRANCE @8 (fragrance), equal to cap e3Point @8; no alphabetical run before the cap; no skipped candidates; no codes; no payload_lipid present.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: light: one deposition family only (two late cationic polymers), no silicone, lipid or film former.
weightPotential.persistence: low: late cationic polymers at trace-like positions; nothing waxy or silicone-based to accumulate.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate: C1 olefin-sulfonate chassis with betaine and sarcosinate buffers.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two cationic polymers (guar derivative and Polyquaternium-7) can deposit at low dose by dilution deposition.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single, late cationic deposition family faces an effective sulfonate chassis; noticeable loss of movement or lift is unlikely.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: only one deposition family (cationic_polymer) is present, both members listed after Parfum, salt and preservative, with no lipid, silicone or film route converging; moderate reset offsets them (W2 does not require more because no second family exists).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Charge density and dose of the two cationic polymers are unknown; identity confidence moderate (tier-4 source).
weightPotential.rationale: Low: single late cationic family, no lipid/silicone, moderate reset. W-line is the cap at Parfum @8 but no payload_lipid exists, so W-LINE gates nothing.
